what_this_measures: Whether each rules engine is reachable from a question phrased the way a real asker phrases it -- measured from the raw string through the OOC gate, decomposition, routing and field extraction to the reply, which is the span no unit test touches.
what_it_cannot_show: Whether these are the phrasings real users produce (R33: the probes were authored by someone who had read the cue lists, so REACHED is a coverage result, never a realism one), and anything that depends on the MODEL fallback in slot extraction, which a FakeBackend cannot supply.
why_this_population: Every engine the system can answer with, two arms each: a natural phrasing that names no acronym or statutory term, and a technical control that does. R31's five instances were all engines whose branches were correct and whose natural phrasings reached nothing, so the population a reachability defect lives in IS the engine list -- not the gate corpora, which are authored in the register that already works (R22).

verdict_meanings.REACHED: expected engine ran; its result is in the reply
verdict_meanings.WRONG_ENGINE: an engine ran, but not the expected one -- a misroute
verdict_meanings.CLARIFIED: routed correctly, never-guess exit fired, no engine result
verdict_meanings.FACT_PATH: routed to `none`; the model answers from RAG. The R31 shape
verdict_meanings.OOC_REFUSED: the refusal gate intercepted an in-scope question
verdict_meanings.ERROR: the harness failed on this row

rows.reply: Kiwango cha kawaida cha kodi ya mapato ya kampuni Tanzania ni asilimia 30 ya faida inayotozwa kodi (First Schedule para 3(1)). Hii ni kiwango — SI hesabu ya TZS kutoka mauzo: faida (si mauzo) ndiyo msingi wa kodi hii, na faida haiwezi kupatikana kutoka mauzo peke yake.

Badala yake, faida au hasara ya ubia hugawanywa kwa kila mshirika kulingana na sehemu yake (Vifungu 49-50), na KILA MSHIRIKA analipa kodi mwenyewe juu ya sehemu yake, kwa kiwango kinachomhusu YEYE — viwango vya mtu binafsi kama mshirika ni mtu, au asilimia 30 kama mshirika ni kampuni. rows.question: Ninalipa pango la ofisi kwa mwezi, nimkate mwenye nyumba kiasi gani?
rows.guards_against: Closed 2026-09-29. Held so the subjunctive fix cannot regress.
rows.reply: Kodi ya zuio kwenye PANGO ni asilimia 10 — kiwango kimoja kwa wakazi NA wasio wakazi (Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato Cap.332, Jedwali la Kwanza aya 4(b)(ii)). Hakuna tofauti ya kiwango kwa sababu ya makao ya mwenye nyumba. Kiwango hiki cha asilimia 10 kinatajwa kwa pango la KIBIASHARA kwenye jedwali la TRA. LAKINI kukata kodi hii ni WAJIBU WA WAKALA WA KUZUIA (withholding agent) tu. Mtu wa kawaida anayelipa pango si wakala wa kuzuia kwa sababu ya kulipa pango peke yake — wajibu huu unamhusu anayefanya biashara/ana wajibu huo kisheria. Kama hujui kama wewe ni wakala wa kuzuia, thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) KABLA ya kukata.
